name: Alma Mater Europaea
summary: Private university in Maribor with study centres in Ljubljana, Koper and Murska Sobota; fee-paying English versions of seven bachelor's degrees.

handoff.label: Tuition and fees for programmes in English

ib.text: The IB Diploma counts as a Slovenian general matura with no recognition step. AMEU applications go through eVŠ; English-taught study is fee-paying for everyone, EU citizens included.

programmes.name: Physiotherapy
programmes.about: Anatomy, physiotherapy and medicine with 920 hours of clinical training in hospitals and spas (180 ECTS). The page says the English version runs only in Maribor, full-time and fee-paying.
programmes.ib: A medical certificate of fitness for physiotherapy, issued in English, is needed at enrolment.
programmes.selectionNote: Enrolment is limited for some fields; if so, ranked on converted IB results under the joint-call rules. Ask AMEU whether an English intake runs in 2027.

programmes.name: Nursing
programmes.about: Three-year nursing degree (180 ECTS) with compulsory clinical training at home and abroad, taught in Maribor and Murska Sobota; the English version is fee-paying.
programmes.ib: A medical certificate from occupational medicine is needed at enrolment.
programmes.selectionNote: Enrolment is limited for some fields; if so, ranked on converted IB results under the joint-call rules. Ask AMEU whether an English intake runs in 2027.

programmes.name: Social Gerontology
programmes.about: Ageing and the needs of older adults from social, psychological and societal angles, in six semesters (180 ECTS); practical training and vaccination certificate are part of enrolment.
programmes.ib: The free full-time study on its page is the Slovene programme; the English version is on the fee-paying tuition list.
programmes.selectionNote: Enrolment is limited for some fields; if so, ranked on converted IB results under the joint-call rules. Ask AMEU whether an English intake runs in 2027.

programmes.name: Business Management
programmes.about: Professional programme (180 ECTS) joining strategy, finance, law, information systems, quality and leadership, with two six-week practical placements and an optional family-business module.
programmes.selectionNote: Enrolment is limited for some fields; if so, ranked on converted IB results under the joint-call rules. Ask AMEU whether an English intake runs in 2027.

programmes.name: Archives Management
programmes.about: Archival science (180 ECTS): creating, classifying, preserving and protecting documents, including electronic records and digital archives.
programmes.selectionNote: Enrolment is limited for some fields; if so, ranked on converted IB results under the joint-call rules. Ask AMEU whether an English intake runs in 2027.

programmes.name: Humanities
programmes.about: Humanities studies (180 ECTS) on ideas, values, history, culture and art, applied to ethics, politics, intercultural relations and technology; hybrid delivery from Ljubljana.
programmes.selectionNote: Enrolment is limited for some fields; if so, ranked on converted IB results under the joint-call rules. Ask AMEU whether an English intake runs in 2027.

programmes.name: Web and Information Technologies
programmes.about: Programming, web and mobile development, data, information security and web analytics in six semesters (180 ECTS); delivered remotely with mostly online exams.
programmes.selectionNote: Enrolment is limited for some fields; if so, ranked on converted IB results under the joint-call rules. Ask AMEU whether an English intake runs in 2027.

notes: AMEU's tuition page for programmes in English also lists Dance, Choreography; it is left out here because the Academy of Dance's own pages are in Slovene.
Only the Physiotherapy page says the degree is taught in English; the other six are listed as English programmes on the tuition page, so confirm with AMEU that an English intake runs in 2027.
Fees shown are the 2025/26 English price list; programmes start in October and later application periods run until September if places remain.
